import { Aside } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

## Symptom

Mid-session, the `papercusp-su` (or `papercusp`) MCP server disconnects. A harness
notice says the server's instructions "no longer apply", and every subsequent
`mcp__papercusp-su__*` call fails with:

```
Error: No such tool available: mcp__papercusp-su__plans_get
```

This is a **session-level client disconnect**, not a transient network blip — it does
**not** recover by retrying within the same turn, and (observed) it stays down across
turn boundaries in that session. READS and WRITES to plans / coordination / docs /
memory are all blocked because those all flow through the MCP tools.

## The trap: don't hand-edit the markdown

The on-disk plan markdown (`apps/operator/docs/plans/<slug>.md`) and docs MDX are
**lagging git-sync PROJECTIONS of the authoritative store**, not the source of truth.
Signs you're looking at a stale projection:

- A `plans:set-status` you already ran returned `ok` with a new `revision.seq`, yet the
  `.md` still shows the old status.
- A freshly-created/-shipped plan's `.md` doesn't exist on disk **anywhere** yet
  (search `find / -name '<slug>.md'` → only the store has it).

If you hand-edit the `.md` to "fix" it, the next git-sync materialization from the store
**clobbers your edit**. So: trust the MCP tool returns (the `revision.seq`) as the
authoritative confirmation, and never patch the projection.

## The fallback: the same tool handlers over the loopback admin API

The operator re-dispatches the *exact same* `defineTool` handlers in-process over its
HTTP admin surface (the mechanism the Plans/Coord admin tabs already use). So a write
you'd do via `plans:set-now` is reachable as `POST /api/admin/plans/set-now`. The body
is the tool's args verbatim; the response is the same envelope the MCP returns.

Authenticate with the **sanctioned local agent credential** — the superuser bearer at
`~/.papercusp/superuser-token` (resolved from `homedir()`, i.e.
`/home/dev/.papercusp/superuser-token`). This is the designed local-agent
token: the operator's own first-party tooling reads it (`plans/runner.ts`,
`operator/converse.ts`, `console-launcher.ts`, gym, oracle) to reach this same admin
surface. It is **not** a bypass.

```bash
TOKEN=$(cat ~/.papercusp/superuser-token | tr -d '\n')   # never echo/log it

# READ first to confirm the store state (verifies your earlier MCP writes landed):
curl -s -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "http://127.0.0.1:3070/api/admin/plans/get?slug=<slug>&harness=<h>&mode=sections"

# WRITE — set-now (args identical to plans:set-now):
curl -s -X POST -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"slug":"<slug>","harness":"<h>","state":"...","next":"...","rationale":"..."}' \
  "http://127.0.0.1:3070/api/admin/plans/set-now?superuser=1"

# WRITE — lifecycle flip (args identical to plans:set-plan-status):
curl -s -X POST -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"slug":"<slug>","harness":"<h>","status":"shipped","expectedCurrent":"active","rationale":"..."}' \
  "http://127.0.0.1:3070/api/admin/plans/set-plan-status?superuser=1"
```

A successful write returns e.g.
`{"ok":true,"results":[{"ok":true,"slug":"...","filePath":"...","revision":{"seq":34}}]}`.

### Verbs & generalization

- **Plans** (`/api/admin/plans/:verb`): reads `list|get|items|search|lint|revisions|…`;
  writes `set-status|set-now|add-decision|add-item|new|set-plan-status|set-content|set-frontmatter|promote|…`.
- **Coordination / inbox**: the `/api/admin/coord`, `/api/admin/coordination`, and
  `/api/admin/inbox` routes re-dispatch to `/api/agent-tools/:group/:verb` in-process
  with a synthesized superuser ctx — same token, same shape.
- **Docs**: an agent-insight is a self-anchoring MDX **file** — write it under
  `apps/operator-docs/src/content/docs/agent-insights/<slug>.mdx` with a `documents:`
  frontmatter list, and the freshness/ingest sweep picks up the anchor. The store-side
  baseline is then stamped by `harness_docs:anchor` (manual docs) or `harness_docs:record`
  (generated) — runnable via the agent-tools route, or just left for the next
  MCP-connected session, since the doc stays "allowed but not-yet-drift-tracked" until anchored.

## Caveats

- **Trust tier.** `/api/admin/*` rejects bare loopback (`trust unverified-loopback not
  in allowlist`); the bearer elevates you to `verified`/`trusted`. Some routes opt into
  `unverified-loopback` (the cookie-less desktop webview, EI-338); the plans route does
  **not** — the token is required.
- **Ports.** `:3070` (the canonical operator) and `:3170` both serve `/api/admin/plans`
  and share the same store; either works. The inference gateway is a different service
  (`:8788`).
- **Never log the token.** Read it into a shell var; keep it out of command echoes and
  tool output.
- **Verify, don't assume.** GET the resource through the same authenticated route after
  writing — that's your authoritative confirmation while the projection catches up.

<Aside type="caution" title="Two things NOT to do">
1. Don't hand-edit the plan/doc markdown — it's a lagging git-sync projection and your edit will be clobbered on the next materialization.
2. Don't hunt for non-sanctioned secrets or try to defeat the trust allowlist. The `~/.papercusp/superuser-token` is the *designed* local-agent credential for exactly this; if it isn't present, stop and report rather than improvising.
</Aside>

## Provenance

First hit 2026-06-29 (su-2183d): the `papercusp-su` MCP dropped after the stability/throttle
work landed, leaving two cosmetic pot-plan writes (`set-now` + `set-plan-status`
draft→shipped) stuck. Completing them via this admin-API + superuser-token path produced
authoritative `revision.seq` bumps and a clean `oldStatus:"draft" → newStatus:"shipped"`,
confirmed by an authenticated read — with no markdown hand-editing.
